summary: This filing is a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $150 million in common stock by Achieve Life Sciences, Inc., through agent Jefferies LLC. The shares will be sold at prevailing market prices under an Open Market Sale Agreement, with Jefferies receiving up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4), not a special situation. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural measures beyond standard ATM mechanics. Investors should monitor the company's periodic filings for actual share sales and dilution impact.
